name: Abijah
bio: Abijah was a son of Jeroboam, Israel's first king, who fell seriously ill. Jeroboam sent his wife, disguised so she would not be recognized, to the prophet Ahijah in Shiloh to learn what would happen to the boy. Though now blind with age, Ahijah recognized her by the sound of her footsteps and delivered a harsh prophecy: judgment on the entire house of Jeroboam for his idolatry, but Abijah alone among them would be given a proper burial and genuine mourning from all Israel, "because in him there is found some good in him toward the LORD, the God of Israel, among the house of Jeroboam." Abijah died the moment his mother stepped through the doorway of their home, just as Ahijah had foretold (1 Kings 14:1-18).
